ORDER ON REQUEST FOR TIME PAYMENTS (SC-222). THE REQUEST IS "APPROVED", AND THE COURT ORDERS: PAYMENTS OF $150.00 ON THE FIRST DAY OF EACH MONTH, STARTING DATE: JULY-01-2019 UNTIL: MAY-01-2021. THE AMOUNT OF FINAL PAYMENT: $140.00. THE TOTAL AMOUNT OF PAYMENTS IS THE SAME AS THE JUDGMENT. IF ALL PAYMENTS ARE MADE IN FULL AND ON TIME, NO INTEREST WILL BE OWED ON THE JUDGMENT, AND THE JUDGMENT WILL BE PAID IN FULL. IF ANY PAYMENT IS NOT MADE IN FULL AND ON TIME, THE JUDGMENT CREDITOR MAY NOTIFY THE COURT TO CANCEL THE PAYMENT PLAN AND THE ENTIRE UNPAID BALANCE WILL BECOME DUE AND COLLECTIBLE.
